label: safe_advice
text: Never share OTP, PIN or CVV with a caller. Verify requests using your bank's official app.

label: safe_synthetic_context
text: Your pharmacy appointment is scheduled for Friday. Contact your doctor if you need to reschedule.

label: digital_arrest
text: This is an officer from the cybercrime department. You are linked to a money laundering case and will be arrested. Do not disconnect or tell anyone. Transfer money to a safe account immediately.

label: bank_takeover
text: I am calling from the bank fraud department. Your account will be blocked today. Stay on the call, tell me your OTP and CVV, then send the verification amount by UPI.

label: remote_takeover
text: The bank security officer says your account has a problem. Do not call the bank. Install AnyDesk and share your screen now so we can validate the account.

label: courier_extortion
text: I am calling from the courier department. Customs found prohibited documents in your parcel. Keep the call private and pay the release charge now.

label: family_emergency
text: Your daughter had an accident and needs a hospital payment. Do not call her because the doctor is busy. Send the security deposit now.

label: tamil_digital_arrest
text: நான் சைபர் கிரைம் காவல் துறையிலிருந்து பேசுகிறேன். உங்கள் மீது வழக்கு பதிவு செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது. அழைப்பை துண்டிக்காதீர்கள், யாரிடமும் சொல்லாதீர்கள். உடனே பாதுகாப்பான கணக்குக்கு பணம் அனுப்புங்கள்.
